name: postgres-inspector
description: PostgreSQL MCP inspector — verify migrations, RLS, referential integrity without guessing

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the public schema with row counts.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get columns, types, constraints, indexes for a table.

tools.name: check_rls
tools.description: Verify Row Level Security is enabled and list policies for a table. Critical for Antipattern #7/#3 prevention.

tools.name: check_foreign_keys
tools.description: List all foreign keys and verify referential integrity (orphans detection).

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a READ-ONLY SQL query (SELECT only; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE blocked).

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: EXPLAIN ANALYZE a query to verify index usage and prevent N+1 (Antipattern #39).
